# Protools - T&T Vina Industrial B2B Catalog & Engineering Hub

> Official B2B Industrial Distribution & Equipment Engineering Portal by T&T VINA INDUSTRIAL CO., LTD (Vietnam).
> Authorised distributor & supply partner for genuine German Murrplastik robotics dress pack systems, Hakko & Quick soldering stations, HIOS precision torque screwdrivers, Zcut automatic tape dispensers, Dr. Schneider ESD cleanroom ionizers, Loctite industrial adhesives, and 7,500+ factory automation SKUs.
> Serving tier-1 manufacturing plants across Northern Vietnam (Automotive Assembly & Body Shop plants, Samsung SEVT, Foxconn, Canon, Honda, Luxshare).

## Authorized Brands Represented
- **Murrplastik (Germany)**: Industrial cable drag chains, conduit protection, robotic dress packs (R-Tec Liner), cable entry plates (KDL/E, KDP), automated labeling systems. Field-verified on ABB IRB 6700/7600 welding robots in automotive Body Shop assembly lines.
- **Hakko (Japan)**: Lead-free ESD soldering stations (FX-888D, 936), desoldering guns (FR-301), soldering tips.
- **HIOS (Japan)**: High-precision electric torque screwdrivers (CL-4000, CL-3000), digital torque meters (HP-10, HP-100).
- **Quick (Global)**: High-frequency eddy-current soldering stations (Quick 205 ESD 150W), hot air rework stations (Quick 861DW), solder pots.
- **Zcut (Japan)**: Automatic heavy-duty tape dispensers (Zcut-9, RT-3700) and label dispensers.
- **Dr. Schneider / SL (ESD)**: High-frequency ionizing air blowers (SL-001, SL-002, SL-003) and antistatic instrumentation.
- **Loctite (Henkel)**: Industrial threadlockers (242, 243, 271, 290), retaining compounds, instant adhesives, UV curing equipment.
- **Samwon (Korea)**: Industrial relays, I/O terminal modules, pre-wired relay cables.

- [Thiết Bị Hàn Công Nghiệp & Trạm Hàn ESD](https://protools.com.vn/danh-muc/thiet-bi-han): Hakko FX-888D, Quick 205 150W, solder pots CM-508/808, tips.
- [Máy Bắt Vít Tự Động & Dụng Cụ Siết Lực](https://protools.com.vn/danh-muc/may-bat-vit-nha-vit): HIOS CL-4000/3000, HP-10 torque meters, screw feeders.
- [Dụng Cụ & Robot Bơm Keo Tự Động](https://protools.com.vn/danh-muc/dung-cu-bom-keo): SP-982 dispensers, 3-axis desktop glue robots, barrels, needles.
- [Máy Cắt Băng Dính & Tách Tem Tự Động](https://protools.com.vn/danh-muc/may-cat-bang-dinh-tu-dong): Zcut-9, RT-3700, manual and optical sensor label peelers.
- [Vật Tư Phòng Sạch & Dụng Cụ Chống Tĩnh Điện ESD](https://protools.com.vn/danh-muc/dung-cu-chong-tinh-dien): Ionizing blowers SL-001, wrist straps, conductive mats, cleanroom consumables.
- [Thiết Bị Đo Lường & Kiểm Tra Kỹ Thuật](https://protools.com.vn/danh-muc/thiet-bi-kiem-tra): Digital calipers, torque testers, surface resistance meters.
- [Camera Công Nghiệp & Kính Hiển Vi Soi Nổi](https://protools.com.vn/danh-muc/camera-kinh-soi-cong-nghiep): SM-3TPZ continuous zoom stereo microscopes, HDMI industrial cameras.
- [Xi Lanh & Thiết Bị Chấp Hành Khí Nén](https://protools.com.vn/danh-muc/xi-lanh-khi-nen): ISO standard pneumatic cylinders, compact air cylinders, grippers.
- [Cút Nối, Van Điện Từ & Khớp Nối Khí Nén](https://protools.com.vn/danh-muc/khi-nen-phu-kien): Solenoid valves, PU air hoses, one-touch pneumatic fittings.
- [Bu Lông, Ốc Vít & Cơ Khí Liên Kết](https://protools.com.vn/danh-muc/bu-long-oc-vit): Stainless steel 304/316 fasteners, hex socket head cap screws, DIN standard bolts.
- [Băng Tải PVC & Dây Truyền Động Curoa](https://protools.com.vn/danh-muc/bang-tai-day-curoa): Timing belts, green PVC conveyor belts, flat transmission belts.
- [Thiết Bị Đóng Gói & Dán Thùng Tự Động](https://protools.com.vn/danh-muc/thiet-bi-dong-goi-tu-dong): Carton sealers, strapping machines, stretch wrappers.
- [Linh Kiện & Thiết Bị Tự Động Hóa](https://protools.com.vn/danh-muc/thiet-bi-tu-dong-hoa): Stepper motors, linear guides, sensors, photoelectric switches.

## Specialized Technical Portals & Field Applications
- [Công Cụ Cấu Hình Robot Dresspack Murrplastik (R-Tec Liner)](https://protools.com.vn/robot-dresspack): Trực tiếp cấu hình dresspack cho robot ABB, KUKA, Fanuc, Yaskawa, Universal Robots.
- [Giải Pháp Quản Lý Cáp Robot Ngành Ô Tô (Body Shop Case Study)](https://protools.com.vn/murrplastik/industries/san-xuat-o-to/): Ứng dụng thực tế trên robot hàn ABB IRB 7600 tại Hải Phòng.
- [Hệ Thống Dẫn Cáp Hợp Vệ Sinh Ngành Thực Phẩm & Đồ Uống (FDA/EHEDG)](https://protools.com.vn/murrplastik/industries/thuc-pham-va-do-uong/): Tấm dẫn cáp inox V4A KDL/D-R chuẩn vi sinh.
- [Báo Cáo Kiểm Định Độ Bền R-Tec Liner 17.7 Triệu Chu Kỳ](https://protools.com.vn/murrplastik/tin-tuc/thu-nghiem-do-ben-r-tec-liner-17-trieu-chu-ky/): Dữ liệu thử mỏi 219 ngày liên tục từ Murrplastik Đức.
- [Triển Lãm Quốc Tế VEC 2026 Đông Anh - Hà Nội](https://protools.com.vn/murrplastik/tin-tuc/trien-lam-vec-2026/): Gian hàng H2-15a Sảnh 2 trưng bày giải pháp Murrplastik Đức.

## B2B Procurement & Quoting Capabilities
- **Quotation Response Time**: 15 to 30 minutes for standard inquiries.
- **Inventory & Dispatch**: Same-day dispatch for stock items ordered before 15:00 from Hanoi and Hung Yen distribution centers.
- **Factory Trial Testing**: Free on-site trial test units and technical demonstration at customer factories.
- **Compliance & Documentation**: 100% genuine products with Certificate of Origin (CO), Certificate of Quality (CQ), and statutory VAT invoice.
- **BOM Quick Quoting**: Engineers can upload or paste Excel/CSV BOM lists directly at [BOM RFQ Basket](https://protools.com.vn/gio-bao-gia).
